title: "Individual assignment 4"

## Practice building data analysis pipelines using GNU Make

The purpose of this assignment is to ensure that everyone gains hands-on practice 
building data analysis pipelines using GNU Make.

### Exercise instructions

1.  Visit [this template GitHub repository](https://github.com/ttimbers/data_analysis_pipeline_practice) 
and click the green "Use this template" button 
to get your own copy of the `data_analysis_pipeline_practice` repository.

2.  Your task is to add a "smarter" data analysis pipeline using GNU Make! 
It should accomplish the same task as `bash runall.sh` when you type `make all`.
It should also reset the analysis the starting point 
(the state when you first copied this repo) when you type `make clean`.

3. After you have the `Makefile` working locally, 
for both the `all` and `clean` targets, 
push your changes to your copy of the `data_analysis_pipeline_practice` 
GitHub repository.

### Submission instructions

You will submit a PDF to Gradescope for individual assignment 4 that includes:

1.  A link to your copy of the GitHub.com repository 
that you created and worked on for this assignment.
    -   It should be named `data_analysis_pipeline_practice`.

## Rubric

This assignment will be graded for completion as follows:

|Grade | Description |
|------|-------------|
| 100% | Working data analysis pipeline via a `Makefile` file exists and it contains both `all` and `clean` targets. |
| -25% | There are errors in the `Makefile` that prevent it from running as expected |
| -25% | The `all` target is missing from the `Makefile` |
| -25% | The `clean` target is missing from the `Makefile` |
| -25% | The `Makefile` dependency tree is incorrect in some way |
| 0%   | The assignment was not attempted. |

- You will only get the extra points for serving up the HTML version of the report on GitHub pages if all of the main assignment components were completed.
